subject: Pricing & committed-use discount inquiry
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@deepfin.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing & token economics — follow-up from demo

Hey Alex —

Great to meet you and Sam today — thanks for walking through DeepFin's inference use case. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying Qs so I can put together a tailored pricing proposal: 

• Recap: you’re planning a staged rollout — 3-month pilot into production. Expected steady-state usage ~8–12M tokens/month (inference) with occasional spikes to ~20M. Embeddings workload ~1–2M tokens/month.
• Key business goals: keep latency under 300ms p95, and unit economics target in the ~$700–$1,000 per 1M tokens range to fit your budget.

A few asks so we can model committed-use discounts precisely:
1) Can you confirm expected average and peak monthly token volumes (inference vs embeddings) for the first 12 months?
2) Do you have an internal target $/1M tokens you’d like us to aim for (for commercial approval)?
3) Would you be open to a 12-month committed-use plan if we can meet your target unit economics? We can layer in our startup program credits for qualifying early-stage customers and additional multi-year incentives.

Attached: Redwood_Startup_Program_Summary.pdf — quick summary of startup credits and eligibility. I’ll also loop in Marissa for commercial approvals once we have the numbers.

Next steps: if you can send the volume confirmation and target $/1M by end of week, I’ll return a committed-use proforma and a short-term startup offer.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

---
Attachment: Redwood_Startup_Program_Summary.pdf (summary PDF, 2 pages)

From: Alex Johnson <alex@deepfin.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@deepfin.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — follow-up from demo

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the doc. Quick answers below: 

• Volumes: pilot months 1–3 we expect roughly 4–6M tokens/month as we ramp, then steady-state 8–12M tokens/month inference. Embeddings ~1M/month. Peak bursts could hit ~18–22M tokens on product launch days.
• Target unit economics: ideally we'd like to be at or below $800 / 1M tokens for inference to hit our LTV/CAC targets.
• Commitment: leadership is open to a 12-month committed use if pricing is predictable and includes startup credits for the pilot quarter. We’d prefer a fixed $/1M for that term rather than variable tiering if possible.

Also curious about multi-year incentives — would a 2-year commitment meaningfully improve rates?

Sam and I are available this Tuesday for a quick follow-up.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product | DeepFin
alex@deepfin.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@deepfin.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@deepfin.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — committed-use options and offer

Alex —

Thanks for the clear numbers — that helps a lot. Based on your steady-state target (8–12M/mo) and the target ~$800 / 1M, here’s a practical proposal that balances predictability and commercial approval from our side: 

1) Baseline (hosted, pay-as-you-go): $1,000 / 1M tokens (inference). Embeddings priced separately — current embedding list: $1,200 / 1M tokens.

2) Committed-use tiers (12-month term, billed monthly against committed bucket):
   • 10–24M tokens/month commit: $750 / 1M (25% off baseline)
   • 25M+ tokens/month commit: $600 / 1M (40% off baseline)

3) Startup program (applies if DeepFin qualifies):
   • 50% off hosted rates for first 3 months OR $40k in credits (your choice), plus a fast-track procurement packet to shorten legal review.

4) Multi-year incentive: add’l 10% off committed rates for a 24-month committed agreement (stackable with the committed-use tier discount). Example: 12-month at 10–24M would be $750 / 1M; 24-month at same band would be $675 / 1M after the extra 10% incentive.

Putting that together for your target: a 12-month commit at 10–12M/month nets you $750 / 1M; combine with startup credits for the pilot quarter to smooth out costs. If you sign up for a 24-month commit we can aim towards $675 / 1M.

I’ve attached a quick proforma (proforma-committed-use-v1.xlsx) that models monthly spend at 8–12M tokens and shows the net monthly bill under each option. Also attached Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf with highlights on SLAs, data handling, and termination clauses.

Next steps — can you: 
• Confirm if DeepFin qualifies for the startup program (basic criteria: < $5M in ARR, recent seed/Series A or incubator backing) — if yes, which startup credit option do you prefer (50% off first 3 months vs $40k credits)?
• Confirm whether you prefer a 12-month fixed-price commit or want to discuss a 24-month deal to get the extra 10% incentive.

I’m pulling Marissa in on commercial terms if we need contract exceptions. If you’re good, I’ll produce a formal proposal + procurement packet and route for signatures.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

---
Attachments: proforma-committed-use-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 tab), Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf (3 pages)

From: Alex Johnson <alex@deepfin.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@deepfin.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — committed-use options and offer

Ben / Marissa —

Appreciate the clear options and the proforma. Good news — DeepFin meets the startup program criteria (we’re Series A, ARR ~ $2.1M). We’d like the $40k credit applied to the pilot quarter rather than the 50% off, since that smooths our runway and simplifies forecasting.

We’re leaning toward the 12-month committed-use at the 10–24M tier (we expect to land around ~12M/month after ramp). That gets us to $750 / 1M which is close to our internal threshold; if we see steady growth we’ll revisit a 24-month conversation later this year.

Please send a formal proposal + procurement packet (PO template, SOW language, and initial contract) and include the $40k startup credit applied to months 1–3. Legal will need ~2 weeks to review. Also include a billing contact (we’ll provide a PO number once the proposal is in hand).

Available for a 30-min sync on Monday to finalize details.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product | DeepFin
alex@deepfin.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123
